critique: The close frontal framing, glossy dark eyes, charcoal face, rose-taupe hairless body, pink nose, white whiskers, and restrained breathing/listening motions convincingly establish a curious guinea pig rather than a pig. Pickles’s exact likeness to the unavailable reference photo remains unverified, and the oversized feet with long triangular claws plus rigid geometric “tufts” should be redrawn as tiny padded cavy feet and finer wiry rust-tan-cream hairs.
